mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the current temperature is 48 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and we have a waxing gibbous moon overhead.

In city news, the Finance Department has finalized the 2027 annual budget. Also, a friendly reminder from Public Works to never pour fats, oils, or grease down your drains as it can clog the community sewer system and cause backups.
We have plenty to look forward to including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, ART House festivities tonight, and the popular Hop Haus trivia tomorrow.
In a report from the police department, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry. Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
